name: adhd
description: ADHD — a skill for coding agents. Tree-of-thought with pruning, built on the Claude & Codex Agent SDK. Fans out parallel divergent thoughts under different cognitive frames, scores, prunes traps, deepens the survivors. The no-brainer skill for creative and interdisciplinary work.

capability_evidence.multi-agent-orchestration: vs 6, novelty 8 vs 3, trap detection ~8 vs ~2.
capability_evidence.billing-metering: ndpoints at 30s; daemonize the CLI with ticket IDs; race 3 LLM replicas, cache the winner.
capability_evidence.agent-runtime: zy debugging, naming, API surface design, strategy, and any prompt of the shape *"give me a few ways to…".
capability_evidence.team-collaboration: Open to collaboration with research labs and applied-AI teams working on reasoning, planning, and agentic systems.
capability_evidence.cross-agent-support: Mentions Claude Code, Cline, Codex, Cursor

friction.note_en: Turnkey. install via npx one-liner, global npm install; needs npm install/build; one-click setup
friction.note_zh: 开箱即用。可通过 npx one-liner、global npm install 安装；需要 npm install/build；one-click setup

analysis.summary_en: Linear Chain-of-Thought anchors on whatever it says first.
highlights: A measured duel vs. single-shot by Shichinomiya (@shichinomiya_s) — independent blind-scored benchmark (2 problems, LLM-as-judge, A/B positions swapped). ADHD won both, with the biggest gai…
🔬 An independent evidence-based research review (11 sources, 8 validation rounds) was published against the method — findings tracked openly as issues #16–#18.
🔌 Adopted by repowire — the first OSS project to officially ship ADHD, ported onto its mesh-orchestrator primitives in PR #313 (merged).
Plus shortlist: scout-fork to alternate endpoints at 30s; daemonize the CLI with ticket IDs; race 3 LLM replicas, cache the winner.
